definitions.gloss: to take out, to bring out
definitions.explanation: To remove something from inside a container or place and bring it outside or into view.
To formally present documents, homework, or applications to someone in authority.

examples.japanese: かばんから{本|ほん}を{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please take the book out of the bag.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}を{出|だ}しましたか。
examples.english: Did you hand in your homework?

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{手紙|てがみ}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I sent a letter to my friend.

examples.japanese: ゴミは{月曜日|げつようび}と{木曜日|もくようび}に{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please put out the garbage on Monday and Thursday.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{出|だ}す{前|まえ}に、もう{一度|いちど}{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check one more time before submitting the documents.

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}から{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}を{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please take the milk out of the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: {財布|さいふ}から{お金|おかね}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took out money from my wallet.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}を{外|そと}に{出|だ}しましたか。
examples.english: Did you let the dog outside?

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}を{会社|かいしゃ}に{出|だ}しました。
examples.english: I submitted my resume to the company.

examples.japanese: {申請書|しんせいしょ}は{来週|らいしゅう}までに{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the application form by next week.

examples.japanese: {レポート|れぽーと}を{先生|せんせい}に{出|だ}すのを{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to hand in the report to the teacher.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}に{年賀状|ねんがじょう}を{出|だ}しましたか。
examples.english: Did you send a New Year's card to your grandmother?

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{両親|りょうしん}に{手紙|てがみ}を{出|だ}しています。
examples.english: I send letters to my parents every month.

examples.japanese: {招待状|しょうたいじょう}はもう{出|だ}しましたか。
examples.english: Have you already sent out the invitations?

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{車|くるま}から{出|だ}すのを{手伝|てつだ}ってください。
examples.english: Please help me take the luggage out of the car.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}にいる{間|あいだ}、{毎月|まいつき}{家族|かぞく}に{手紙|てがみ}を{出|だ}して、{元気|げんき}だと{知|し}らせていました。
examples.english: While I was in Japan, I sent letters to my family every month to let them know I was doing well.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {出|で}る (intransitive). Pattern: Xを{出|だ}す (take out X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action or result. {出|だ}している = 'is putting out' or 'has taken out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{手紙|てがみ}を{出|だ}す (send a letter)
・{宿題|しゅくだい}を{出|だ}す (submit homework)
・ゴミを{出|だ}す (put out trash)
・{声|こえ}を{出|だ}す (speak up/make a sound)

AUXILIARY: V-stem + {出|だ}す = start doing suddenly: {走|はし}り{出|だ}す (start running), {泣|な}き{出|だ}す (burst into tears).

PAIR: {出|で}る (intransitive) - {結果|けっか}が{出|で}た (results came out).
